hooks.command: : "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:?CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA is not set}" && : "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:?CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is not set}" && mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && rm -rf "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/scripts" && cp -r "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/scripts" && (diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" . && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npx playwright install chromium) || rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json")
